briefdescription.para: ACVP SLH-DSA-sigGen-FIPS205 sample vector for a pure message longer than 4096 bytes.

detaileddescription.para: Source: usnistgov/ACVP-Server gen-val/json-files/SLH-DSA-sigGen-FIPS205 Group tgId 25, test tcId 215: parameterSet SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s deterministic true, signatureInterface external, preHash pure context empty, message 5377 bytes, signature 7856 bytes
